text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
We caught so many!
Thank you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought, the lining is properly done too.
The stitching isn't sloppy at all, it's very neat...
and I don't see any fraying.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's wonderful quality,
radiating pure love for Umamusume♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should try making clothes for them too...?
The ultimate outfit to make them sparkle♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I wish there was a "Paka Puchi" of you too, Trainer. If there were, I could dress us up in matching outfits and place them side by side...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Why not just make one from scratch!
I'll make it so cute it won't lose to any of these little guys!
